label: Responsive Docs Tester
description: Build and serve a local web app or docs site, then test it with Playwright across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports on a recurring schedule
tips: Build and start the app or docs site locally in a pre-step, then poll localhost until the server responds before Playwright navigates to it
Test a small, named set of representative viewports (e.g. one mobile, one tablet, one desktop size) rather than an open-ended device list
Use playwright-cli commands in bash (browser_resize, browser_navigate, browser_snapshot) instead of installing Playwright as an npm dependency
Check navigation usability, content overflow, image sizing, and basic accessibility (headings, alt text, contrast) at each viewport, not just that the page loads
Capture screenshots only on failure and publish them with the upload-asset safe output so evidence is attached without bloating the report
Always stop the local preview server in a cleanup step even if earlier steps fail
Call noop when every viewport passes instead of leaving no output
Set expires and close-older-issues (or skip-if-match) on create-issue so scheduled runs don't accumulate duplicate reports
